scope: sampled visual and story review; ASR and measured signal support; no validated audio listening
product_from_film: Tuyo presents payments where some purchases can become free.
explains_well: A flower purchase moves from a transaction list to a free result and a real shop setting.
unclear: The film does not explain which purchases qualify, the chance of a free purchase or how the user joins.
scenario: Pay at shops and receive a possible free-purchase result.
product_clear_basis: Fresh Flowers changes from $69.99 to FREE.

lessons.keep: Carry one merchant and amount across list, result and real setting.
lessons.avoid: Avoid presenting a chance-based reward without explaining its basic conditions.
lessons.open: Eligibility, odds, payment setup, notification authenticity, footage origin and all audio remain unverified.
try: Show a named Tin campaign from its list row to a published result, keeping its title visible.
Add a short rule beside a surprising reward so viewers understand what caused it.

comparison.story: Turn routine spending into a question about delight. → Give the free purchase a concrete context. → Extend the idea across familiar purchases. → State the chance-based premise. → Offer a next step. → No further visible message.
comparison.motion: Merchant rows shift, one row brightens, the phone rotates and prices are replaced by FREE. Exact paths and easing are unverified. Sampling scope: 1 fps unless a closer window is recorded.
